name: ONNX Runtime documentation
notes:
ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform machine-learning model accelerator by Microsoft. Supports models from PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, TFLite, scikit-learn. Provides hardware-specific execution providers for CUDA, TensorRT, OpenVINO, DirectML, ROCm, CPU. Documentation at onnxruntime.ai/docs.
